# Let's build a simple circuit:
# battery anode -> black wire terminal 1
# black wire terminal 2 -> anode in blue light bulb
# blue light bulb cathode -> red wire terminal 1
# red wire terminal 2 -> unknown substance
# unknown substance -> green wire terminal 1
# green wire terminal 2 -> battery cathode

circuit_actions = [
    "connect anode in battery to black wire terminal 1",
    "connect black wire terminal 2 to anode in blue light bulb",
    "connect blue light bulb cathode to red wire terminal 1",
    "connect red wire terminal 2 to unknown substance",
    "connect unknown substance to green wire terminal 1",
    "connect green wire terminal 2 to battery cathode",
]

for act in circuit_actions:
    valid = filter_actions(include=act[:25], startswith="connect", limit=80)
    if act in list_actions():
        res = step_text_action(act)
        print(act, "->", res.get("observation_after"), "score:", check_success().get("score"))
    else:
        print("MISSING ACTION:", act)
        print("Similar:", valid[:10])

# Wait 1 step or look at blue light bulb to see if it turned on!
print("Look after connecting:\n", look())
res_wait = step_text_action("wait1") if "wait1" in list_actions() else step_text_action("look at blue light bulb")
print("After wait/look:", res_wait.get("observation_after"))
print("Look after wait:\n", look())
print("Status:", check_success())
print("Move/pick actions for unknown substance:", filter_actions(include="unknown substance", limit=80))
